title: Engineered MCM-48 and heteropolyacid based hybrid nano-drug delivery systems for controlled release of metformin hydrochloride for diabetes mellitus treatment
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,33657-33666
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03450G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Debatrayee Dasgupta, Anjali Patel
In vitro dissolution of MTF/TPA/nMCM-48 was studied to overcome limitations of MTF. The release profile was compared with a marketed formulation and cytotoxicity was tested on a liver cancer cell line for anticancer potential.
